title: Block Distracting Apps for a 30-Minute Study Session
description: For one study session, choose distracting apps and start a 30-minute Block Now session.
direct: For one study session, choose distracting apps and start a 30-minute Block Now session. A notification-silencing Focus mode can help with interruptions, but it does not by itself prevent you from opening a distracting app.
figureAlt: A notebook, face-down phone and thirty-minute timer illustrate a study session.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot, measured result or real export.
cards.choice.heading: Pick a small block list
cards.choice.body: Keep the apps you need for the assignment available. A dictionary, course conversation or authenticator may be essential even when other apps on the same phone are distractions. Write down the next study task before starting.
sections.explain.heading: Understand the escape options
sections.explain.body: The app offers temporary unlocks of 5, 15 or 30 minutes. This is useful friction, not an impossible-to-bypass device lock. If you require an essential app during the session, use the available exit deliberately and reconsider your next selection.
sections.practice.heading: Session versus recurring routine
sections.practice.body: Block Now is an immediate one-off boundary; the separate scheduling feature is for repeating work or bedtime windows. Our iPhone app includes unlimited Block Now sessions and one scheduled rule free. Pro adds unlimited scheduled rules. Space Sheep Studio develops Dying Soon. The app’s life grid is a reflection tool, not a health prediction, and optional reminders are not required for this study workflow. No productivity outcome is guaranteed.

related.related.label: Related practical guide
steps.step-1.text: In Dying Soon: Screen Time Limit, grant the requested Apple Screen Time access and select distracting apps.
steps.step-2.text: Start Block Now for its 30-minute focus session. Test a selected app to confirm that the blocking boundary is active.
steps.step-3.text: Study the chosen task, then review what interrupted you. Adjust the selected apps before the next session rather than blocking everything.
